title: What a cache does
desc: A cache keeps a copy of what you used recently, close at hand, so you do not have to fetch it again.

hub.name: Cache
hub.text: A small, fast place that holds copies.

facts.name: Fast
facts.text: Answers in a blink, because it is near.

facts.name: Small
facts.text: Holds only a little, so it keeps what is popular.

facts.name: Temporary
facts.text: Old copies expire so they never go stale.

facts.name: A copy, not the original
facts.text: The real data stays in the database.

analogy.label: Like a desk and a library

left.name: Your desk
left.text: The books you use every day are within reach.

right.name: The library
right.text: Everything is here, but it takes a walk.
